statement: Every employee in New Zealand must have a written employment agreement, and the employer must give every employee a written employment agreement stating what is expected from them and what they are entitled to while working for the employer.
caveat: The duty and the mandatory agreement contents sit in Employment Relations Act 2000 ss 63A-65 (legislation.govt.nz answers automated fetches with an AWS WAF challenge, recorded 2026-10-23); agreements can be individual or collective, and Employment New Zealand publishes a free agreement builder. Check the live guidance for the required terms before hiring.
